name: One input fans into many outputs
looks: A single small source card sits at left under a headline ("One in. Everything out."); several near-identical output cards fan out from behind it to the right, each slightly offset in position and rotation, each labelled with a different output format, then settle square in a loose row.
build: Output cards start stacked directly behind the source card and tween to their fanned positions (`x`, `rotate`) on a short stagger, 60-80ms apart, power2.out, each with a touch of overshoot as it settles.
sound: A quick flutter of soft pops, one per card, fast enough to read as one fanning gesture.
prompt: Under a headline promising one input and many outputs, fan a handful of near-identical result cards out from behind a single source card, each labelled with a different format, settling into a loose row with a touch of overshoot, so one shot shows the full range at once.
